verdict.rationale: Martin is an agentic personal assistant that acts on real email, calendar, Slack and SMS accounts, so a sandbox or test mode that avoids touching live data is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test environment, or dry-run mode. Every integration acts directly on the user's connected accounts, and no API spec was found.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
